site.tagline: Software and hardware for schools, shops, showrooms, gyms and sports venues.
site.vision: To put dependable, easy-to-use software in the hands of every small and growing business in India — in their own language, on the devices they already carry.
site.mission: We build focused products that replace paper registers, missed follow-ups and end-of-day guesswork with clear, simple screens that any team member can use on day one.

principles.title: Simple for staff, clear for owners
principles.text: Every screen is designed so the newest team member can use it, while owners see the whole picture at a glance.

principles.title: Built for India
principles.text: GST-ready billing, UPI and Razorpay payments, WhatsApp messages and regional-language support across our products.

principles.title: Your data stays yours
principles.text: Each school, shop, showroom or branch keeps its own separate space, with roles that decide who can see what.

quotes: Great software feels like a good shop assistant: quiet, quick and always right.
Build it simple enough for the newest staff member and strong enough for the owner.
Every business, every language, every device.
We build tools that give owners their evenings back.
Small businesses run India. Their software should work as hard as they do.
